an5.68:1.1: ‘‘Pubbevāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno pañca dhamme bhāvesiṃ, pañca dhamme bahulīkāsiṃ .
an5.68:1.8: So kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ ussoḷhipañcamānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ abhiññāsacchikiriyāya,
an5.68:1.9: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
an5.68:2.1: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhiṃ – ‘anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ…pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyya’nti,
an5.68:2.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
an5.68:3.1: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhiṃ…pe… ‘āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya’nti,
an5.68:3.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane’’ti.
